official_source_url.value: The official Embassy of Guinea-Bissau in Portugal confirms passport renewal requires '1 (uma) foto' (one photograph) among the submitted documents, but publishes no dimensions, background colour, or other technical photo specification.

cross_verification.note: Guinea-Bissau's passport-issuing authority is DGICRAN (Direcção-Geral de Identificação Civil, Registo e Arquivo Nacional, under the Ministry of Justice). Its digital government portal, gov-gb.com, was directly fetched and does publish a photo spec — '3x4cm, fundo branco (white background), recent' — but that spec is explicitly for the Bilhete de Identidade (national ID card), a different document from the passport, so it was NOT applied to this passport record to avoid conflating document types. No dedicated official page describing passport-specific photo technical requirements could be located; the Portugal-embassy consular checklist (directly fetched, confirmed official) only requires 'one current photograph' with no further specification. A domain 'evisa.gov.gw' referenced in aggregator summaries failed DNS resolution and was not used.
